description: This Java class 'FlexibleMapAccessor' provides flexible access to Map values, supporting nested expressions, list indexing, and localization features. It includes methods for retrieving, setting, and removing values from maps, with caching and expression parsing capabilities.

classes.name: FlexibleMapAccessor
classes.description: A utility class for flexible access and manipulation of Map entries, supporting nested expressions, list indexing, and localization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to retrieve a cached or new instance of FlexibleMapAccessor based on the original expression string.

methods.name: containsNestedExpression
methods.description: Checks if the accessor contains a nested expression.

methods.name: getOriginalName
methods.description: Returns the original expression string used to create this accessor.

methods.name: getIsAscending
methods.description: Indicates if the accessor is set to ascending order.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the accessor is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the map based on the accessor's expression, with optional locale support.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sets a value in the map at the location specified by the accessor's expression.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the map at the location specified by the accessor's expression.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Constructs the expression string used for map evaluation based on the internal state.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the original expression string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the original expression string.
